title: GTA 6 threw a music festival in Miami 🎤
subject: gta6
description:
Would you have entered the ticket lottery? 👇

Rockstar Games and PlayStation held Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival at Mana Wynwood in Miami on November 21, two days after GTA 6 launched. Rockstar says all ticket proceeds go to local Miami charities. Justice's 30-track GTA 6 Original Score releases December 11.

Sources: Rockstar Games festival announcement via VGC (Nov 9, 2026), Rockstar on X via DancehallMag (Nov 20, 2026), Kurrco on X via HappyGamer (Nov 22, 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: GTA 6 got its own music festival in Miami.
On November 21, two days after launch, Rockstar and PlayStation took over Mana Wynwood for one night.
scenes.search: music festival crowd stage lights night

scenes.text: Cardi B, Metro Boomin and Justice were on the bill. Clips on X show Travis Scott and Don Toliver performing CAN'T SAY.
Getting in took a ticket lottery, and Rockstar says every dollar from ticket sales goes to local Miami charities.
Justice also scored the game, and that 30-track album arrives on December 11.
